cv.title: Analytical Engineer
summary: Analytical engineer with experience across warehouse modelling, pipeline reliability and stakeholder-facing reporting in synthetic fixture organisations.

bullets: Own end-to-end batch pipelines from ingestion through warehouse transformations to reporting consumption.
Document reusable SQL models across landing and aggregated layers to centralise fixture business logic.
Maintain orchestrated data workflows with version-controlled change history.

projects.name: Attribution Rebuild
bullets: Designed incremental enrichment pipelines for fixture traffic-source attribution.
Validated the rebuilt model against production output with controlled backfills.
Delivered a reproducible methodology note for the analytics team.
Built fixture reporting models spanning marketing and revenue domains.
Reduced manual reporting effort through scheduled model refreshes.
